name: Casar de Palomero (Spain)
description: Purple field with a white cross set towards the hoist, charged at its centre with the crowned municipal arms of Casar de Palomero (a tree, a cross and a chalice, inscribed VILLA DE CASAR DE PALOMERO).
history: Municipal flag of Casar de Palomero; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: cross throughout set towards the hoist
